Metadata.defaultDescription: SAGOTRA brings together Yogyakarta's heritage, arts, culinary traditions, and local communities as authentic, meaningful travel experiences.

Footer.description: SAGOTRA connects Indonesian heritage, arts, culinary traditions, local communities, and creativity into one meaningful tourism ecosystem.

Home.heroTitle: A gateway to meaningful Indonesian experiences
Home.heroSubtitle: SAGOTRA presents Yogyakarta's heritage, arts, culinary traditions, and community life as connected experiences — not just a list of tour packages.
Home.featuredSubheading: SAGOTRA's first destination — from royal palaces and heritage residences to living arts communities.
Home.pillarsHeading: Four pillars of the SAGOTRA experience
Home.pillarsSubheading: Every experience we offer begins with one of these pillars, connected together into one cultural tourism ecosystem.
Home.storyBody: Behind every palace, heritage residence, and studio we introduce, there is a community caring for tradition day by day. SAGOTRA is here to tell that story honestly — not as a spectacle, but as a conversation.
Home.howItWorksHeading: From inspiration to a real experience
Home.howItWorksBody: Explore our stories and experiences, find what matches your interests, then send an inquiry through WhatsApp or a short form. Our team will reply with availability, pricing, and a proposed itinerary.
Home.howItWorksStep1Body: Browse our stories and experience catalog by interest, audience, and location.
Home.howItWorksStep2Body: Reach us on WhatsApp or the form with your dates, group size, and interests.
Home.howItWorksStep3Body: The SAGOTRA team replies with availability, pricing, and a proposed itinerary.
Home.conversionBody: Tell us your interests, dates, and group size — we'll help put together an experience that fits.

community.title: Community & Creative Life

About.nameBody: SAGOTRA represents the spirit of kinship and togetherness — a value we find in every community we work with.
About.mandalaBody: Mandala Pengalaman is our framework for weaving heritage, arts, culinary traditions, and community life into one complete, meaningful journey.
About.partnersBody: SAGOTRA works together with local communities and cultural practitioners. Partner names and logos are shown with permission and full respect for their contribution.
About.valuesBody: We believe good tourism is tourism that respects the communities, cultural spaces, and traditions it visits.
